items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: The interviewee only repeats the interviewer's identification of Doc Johnson as the owner of the building where Bill Bottoms worked; no personal interaction or relationship with Doc Johnson is stated by the interviewee.

ctx.x: Well, he may have given up management just for a short time

or subleased it or something. What I was going to say is, you know, to be truthful about it, Dr. Johnson, Dr. Johnson, I think, it was his building. And I'm thinking after Bill Bottoms, I'm not too sure about this, but I'm thinking Dr. Johnson taking it back over after Bill Bottoms. Mm-hmm.
And then Bill Bottoms taking it back again?
